exports.title: Export requests
exports.subtitle: Data-subject access and portability requests (GDPR art. 15/20).

erasures.title: Erasure queue
erasures.subtitle: Accounts waiting to be erased, and the holds that stop them (GDPR art. 17).

empty.pending: No account is waiting out its grace period.
empty.ready: No account is ready to be erased.

state.pending: Waiting. The grace period ends on {date}.
state.ready: The grace period has ended and nothing stands in the way.
state.blocked: The grace period has ended, but it cannot be erased: {reasons}.

in_progress.db_done: The database step is done. The files and the audit log are still to be finished.
in_progress.incomplete: The last run stopped before it finished. This needs an engineer: follow the erasure runbook.

blocker.payment: a payment is still in progress
blocker.delivered_work: delivered work has not been completed
blocker.vendor: a payout provider account is still connected
blocker.not_erasable: it has no creator profile to erase

hold.title: Place a hold
hold.description: While an account is on hold, nobody can erase it. The creator is told nothing, and can still cancel a deletion request: the hold stays.

release.title: Release the hold
release.description: The account can be erased again once its grace period has ended.

dialog.no_personal_details: Do not write names, email addresses or other personal details here: the reason is kept in the audit log permanently.

erasures.capped: Only the first {count} accounts that are due are checked at a time. Handle these, then reload.
erasures.action_failed: This could not be saved. Please try again.

hold.claimed: This account is already being erased, so it cannot be held.
